Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Nutcakes are a kind of [[Cake]] that can be made by [[Cooking]] either an [[Acorn]] or a [[Chickaloo Tree Nut]] together with [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], and [[Goat Butter]]. Eating them will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These Cakes have a pleasant texture and a simple sweetness, both of which come from the use of nuts. At [[The Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]], Link can find ''[[Misa's Recipe Book]]'', which contains a [[Recipe]] for Nutcake. [[Misa]] first instructs the reader to purchase Tabantha Wheat, Goat Butter, and Cane Sugar from her [[General Store]].{{Cite|First, you'll want to buy {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|cane sugar}} here at the {{Color BotW|Blue|Slippery Falcon}}.|Misa's Recipe Book|BotW}} She then says to throw them into a [[Cooking Pot]] with nuts of one's choice, though she prefers Acorns.{{Cite|Toss these ingredients in a pot alongside the nuts of your choice to make a tasty {{Color BotW|Blue|nutcake}}! I prefer {{Color BotW|Blue|acorns}} myself.|Misa's Recipe Book|BotW}} Link can add a fifth [[Ingredient]] when making Nutcake, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Nutcake}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Nutcake}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Nutcake}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. Consuming them will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Nutcake}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. These Cakes can be eaten to refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Nutcake}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. Link can eat them to have his movement speed increased. * '''Hearty Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Nutcake}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain [[Extra Heart]]s. * '''Mighty Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Nutcake}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredient. When consumed, Link will gain a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Nutcake}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredient. Eating these Cakes will provide a boost to Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Nutcake}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Nutcake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Nutcake}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Forest nuts give this cake a pleasant texture and a simple, understated sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. They can be eaten to increase Link's defensive abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cake * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Cakes, Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }} [[de:Nusskuchen]]
